name: Magic and Slash - Minarai Boukensha Lille no H na Daibouken
original_name: マジック＆スラッシュ - 見習い冒険者リルのHな大冒険 -
source:
The stage for this tale takes place in a small and remote village called "Cane village". 

The paths leading to the village suddenly change into a deep forest, in addition many fierce monsters make this forest their abode which threatens the peace of the village.

The innkeeper of the village Luis writes a letter to his older sister Tanya, an adventurer by trade, requesting her assistance to investigate the cause of the sudden changes.

After receiving the letter, Tanya brings her disciple Lille along and heads towards the village where Luis is waiting... 

[Own translation based on official story blurb from http://lunasoft.jp/product/lus007/about.html]
translation:
故事发生在名为“凯恩村”的偏远小村庄。

通往村庄的道路突然变成了一片深邃森林，许多凶猛怪物也在森林中筑巢，威胁着村庄的和平。

村里的旅馆老板路易斯写信给姐姐塔妮娅，请求身为冒险家的她调查道路突然改变的原因。

收到信后，塔妮娅带上弟子莉尔，前往路易斯等候的村庄……

（根据官方网站故事简介自译：http://lunasoft.jp/product/lus007/about.html）
